episodes.title: Kai of Lag Village
episodes.summary: Kai's destiny changes when he reproduces an ability that he saw in a strange dream.

episodes.title: Lady Jose
episodes.summary: Kai travels to Eda Village with Lady Jose, who teaches him about the duty of guardian bearers.

episodes.title: Arbitration God
episodes.summary: Kai returns to the valley where his journey started, where he learns more about the valley god.

episodes.title: A Small Paradise
episodes.summary: Kai's accomplishments attract the attention of Vezin, and Kai recalls a childhood memory.

episodes.title: The Priest and the Inspector
episodes.summary: An inspector from the central plain visits Rag Village, and Kai escorts a priest following an org band.

episodes.title: Rigdaros
episodes.summary: Kai battles Adurakan, a powerful org guardian bearer, in order to protect the valley.

episodes.title: Truthseeker
episodes.summary: The scouting party returns to Rag Village only to learn it was devastated by an attack during their absence.

episodes.title: To Ispi Rio
episodes.summary: Kai and Nada fight for their lives while Lag Village defends itself from another macaque attack.

episodes.title: The Power of God
episodes.summary: Macaques come flooding through the gate opened by the inspector. Will Kai arrive in time to save Lag Village?

episodes.title: The Great God Kanae
episodes.summary: The macaques ask Kai to save them from the evil Great God Kanae.

episodes.title: Diabo
episodes.summary: Kai and his allies confront the diabo, but it is not easily defeated.

episodes.title: Protector of Kanae
episodes.summary: Kai's life is slowly drained away after being swallowed by the diabo when he hears a voice...
